g1|variants|consignment.summary: Customer consignment processes allow companies to store goods at a customer location while retaining ownership until the customer consumes or sells them. Variants differ by the business phase (Pick-up, Issue, Return, Fill-up) and whether billing or inventory movement is immediately triggered.

variants.name: Consignment Fill-up
variants.when_used: Delivering stock to customer location for consignment storage without transferring ownership.
variants.key_config: Sales document type KB uses item category KBN with special stock indicator W, triggering movement 631 for consignment fill-up.

variants.name: Consignment Issue
variants.when_used: Customer consumes stock from consignment inventory, triggering ownership transfer and billing.
variants.key_config: Sales document type KE uses item category KEN with special stock indicator W, issuing stock via movement 633 and billing the customer.

variants.name: Consignment Pickup
variants.when_used: Retrieving unsold consignment inventory from the customer location back to our plant.
variants.key_config: Sales document type KA uses item category KAN with special stock indicator W, bringing physical stock back via movement 634.

variants.name: Consignment Returns
variants.when_used: Customer returns previously issued consignment stock that they had already consumed and billed.
variants.key_config: Sales document type KR uses item category KRN, returning stock to consignment inventory via movement 632 with credit memo.

g1|core|consignment|consignment fill-up.title: Consignment Fill-up (Order-to-Cash)
g1|core|consignment|consignment fill-up.story: Imagine you send boxes of toys to a store to keep on their shelves, but you still own the toys until they sell them. This process moves stock from your warehouse to the customer's consignment stock location without billing them yet, using sales document type KB.
g1|core|consignment|consignment fill-up.why_business_needs_it: It allows a company to place inventory closer to the customer to speed up sales, ensuring the customer only pays when the goods are actually used or sold, while maintaining accurate stock ownership in SAP S/4HANA.

modules.role: Creates the consignment fill-up order (KB), triggers the outbound delivery, and hands off shipping requirements to inventory management without generating a billing document.
modules.hands_off_to: MM-IM (Inventory Management) for goods issue posting (movement type 631) to move stock into special customer consignment stock.

modules.role: Processes the physical movement of goods out of company-owned stock into customer consignment stock based on the outbound delivery.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for updating stock values if configured, though fill-ups are typically non-valuated in standard special stock setups.

modules.role: Tracks the balance sheet transfer of stock from unrestricted-use to special customer consignment stock.

g1|core|consignment|consignment issue.title: Consignment Issue
g1|core|consignment|consignment issue.story: Think of keeping toys at a friend's house where you only pay for the ones you actually play with at the end of the day. In SAP Order-to-Cash, Consignment Issue (KE) allows a company to issue stock from consignment inventory to a customer, transferring ownership and creating a customer invoice only upon consumption.
g1|core|consignment|consignment issue.why_business_needs_it: This process allows companies to maintain stock at the customer location without immediate revenue recognition, improving customer service while retaining ownership until actual usage occurs. It ensures timely billing and accurate inventory reduction based on actual customer consumption.

modules.role: Receives the consignment issue order KE, processes the delivery with movement type 633, and generates the billing document based on delivery quantity.
modules.hands_off_to: MM (Materials Management) for stock posting and FI (Financial Accounting) for revenue posting.

modules.role: Manages consignment stock special stock indicators and executes goods movement type 633 to post goods issue from customer consignment stock.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for inventory valuation updates.

modules.role: Posts revenue, cost of goods sold, and customer receivables when the consignment issue billing document is created.

g1|core|consignment|consignment pickup.title: Consignment Pickup
g1|core|consignment|consignment pickup.story: Consignment Pickup is the process where a customer returns unsold consignment stock back to our warehouse, and we receive it back onto our books without immediately owing them money. Technically, the sales department creates an order type KA with item category KAN, which triggers an outbound delivery with movement type 634 to move the physical stock from customer consignment special stock back to company-owned plant stock.
g1|core|consignment|consignment pickup.why_business_needs_it: This business process allows companies to retrieve unsold goods from a customer location when the consignment agreement ends or inventory needs rotation, ensuring accurate inventory valuation and physical stock reconciliation without generating a financial credit memo. Without it, customer consignment inventory remains indefinitely parked at customer sites, leading to inaccurate stock reporting and potential inventory shrinkage.

modules.role: Manages the customer consignment pickup order KA, schedule lines, pricing exclusions, and triggers the logistics execution hand-off.
modules.hands_off_to: LE-SHP to generate the outbound delivery and execute physical goods movement.

modules.role: Controls outbound delivery creation for document type LF, picking, and posting goods issue using movement type 634.
modules.hands_off_to: MM-IM to post the physical inventory movement and update special stock O.

modules.role: Executes the inventory posting for movement type 634, transferring stock from customer consignment to company-owned unrestricted stock.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-GL / CO for valuation tracking if any cost-of-goods-sold clearing is triggered.

g1|core|consignment|consignment returns.title: Consignment Returns
g1|core|consignment|consignment returns.story: When a customer sends back unsold consignment goods that they previously stored at their location, the system records the physical return and restores it to stock without issuing an immediate credit until the return is formally inspected and billed. Technically, Consignment Returns (KR) process customer-owned stock back into company-managed consignment inventory through a dedicated sales document type KR, sales item category KRN, schedule line category DN, and movement type 632, ultimately triggering billing relevance G for credit settlement.
g1|core|consignment|consignment returns.why_business_needs_it: This process ensures accurate accounting and inventory tracking when customers return goods they never actually purchased. It enables precise control over customer consignment stock balances and protects financial reporting by separating physical returns from billing until final inspection.

modules.hands_off_to: MM-IM to update inventory balances and FI for valuation.

modules.role: Executes movement type 632 to post the returned goods back into special customer consignment stock.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-GL/CO for inventory posting and accounting valuation.

modules.role: Processes the billing document generated from billing relevance G and posts the customer credit memo.

config_steps.where: VOV6 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Define Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.values: Schedule Line Category: DN; Order qt.suppl: X; Movement type: 632; Item category: K
config_steps.check: Verify schedule line category DN configuration in table TVEP using SE16N.
config_steps.why: Schedule line categories drive delivery requirements and inventory movement types.
config_steps.if_missing: Without schedule line category DN, the system cannot trigger inbound delivery postings.
actions: Enter /nVOV6 in the command field and press Enter
Select schedule line category DN and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Schedule Line Category with DN and Description with Return Consignment S.L.
Set Order qt.suppl. to X
Set Movement type to 632
Set Item category to K
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Triggers consignment return goods receipt into customer consignment stock.

config_steps.step: Assign Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.where: VOV5 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Assign Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Assign Schedule Line Categories": Details
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: KR; Item Category: KRN; Schedule Line Category: DN
config_steps.check: Create a sales order in VA01 and check that schedule line category DN populates automatically on the item schedule line tab.
config_steps.why: This mapping ensures sales orders automatically pull the correct schedule line category for execution.
config_steps.if_missing: Missing assignment causes error message V1314 when creating the sales order.
actions: Enter /nVOV5 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Doc Type KR
Enter Item Category KRN
Enter Schedule Line Category DN
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Define Inbound Delivery Document Type
config_steps.where: OVL0 -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Document Types
config_steps.values: Delivery Type: EL; Description: Inbound Delivery; Number range int.: 19; Number range ext.: 29
config_steps.check: Check table T390 using SE16N to confirm delivery type EL settings.
config_steps.why: Inbound delivery types control logistical processing parameters for incoming physical stock.
config_steps.if_missing: Without delivery type EL, warehouse operators cannot process inbound return deliveries.
actions: Enter /nOVL0 in the command field and press Enter
Select delivery type EL and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Delivery Type with EL and Description with Inbound Delivery
Set Number range int. to 19 and Number range ext. to 29
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

External number range for inbound deliveries.

config_steps.step: Assign Delivery Type and Line Rule
config_steps.where: VOV2 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Assign Delivery Type
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type: KR; Dlv. Type: EL; Ref. mandatory: X
config_steps.check: Run VL01N referencing a consignment return order and verify delivery type EL defaults automatically.
config_steps.why: This configuration connects the sales order type to the correct inbound delivery type.
config_steps.if_missing: If unassigned, VL01N fails to determine the delivery type for order KR.
actions: Enter /nVOV2 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Document Type KR
Enter Dlv. Type EL
Set Ref. mandatory to X
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Check Movement Type 632 Configuration
config_steps.where: OMJJ -- SPRO > Materials Management > Inventory Management and Physical Inventory > Movement Types > Copy, Change Movement Types
config_steps.values: Movement Type: 632; Short Text: Returns consig. to cust.; Value Updating: X; Quantity Updating: X; Special Stock: W
config_steps.check: Execute transaction MB58 to verify customer consignment stock balances update correctly after goods receipt.
config_steps.why: Movement type 632 directs inventory posting into customer-specific consignment stock accounts.
config_steps.if_missing: Incorrect movement type settings cause goods receipt failure with error M7001.
actions: Enter /nOMJJ in the command field and press Enter
Select Movement type 3 and click View
Enter 632 in the Movement Type field and press Enter
Verify Short Text is Returns consig. to cust.
Ensure Value Updating and Quantity Updating are checked
Confirm Special Stock indicator is set to W
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Updates financial value in inventory accounting.

config_steps.step: Maintain Customer and Material Consignment Records
config_steps.where: MM01 -- Logistics > Materials Management > Material Master > Material > Create (General)
config_steps.values: Material: Consignment Material; Industry Sector: M; Material Type: FERT; Sales Org: 1000; Dist. Channel: 10
config_steps.check: Run transaction MM03 to verify the material has active sales and plant views.
config_steps.why: Master data prerequisites ensure sales orders and inventory movements reference valid products.
config_steps.if_missing: Without material master data, order creation fails due to non-existent material numbers.
actions: Enter /nMM01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Material code, Industry Sector M, and Material Type FERT
Click Select Views and choose Sales: Sales Org. Data 1 and Sales: General/Plant
Enter Plant 1000 and Storage Location 1000
Enter Sales Org 1000 and Dist. Channel 10
Save (Ctrl+S) to create the material master record

fields.note: Mechanical engineering or general industry sector.

run_steps.result: Sales order of type KR is created with item category KRN and schedule line DN referencing customer consignment stock.
Inbound delivery document of type EL is generated referencing the KR sales order.
Goods receipt is posted using movement type 632, updating inventory into customer consignment stock (E stock).
Billing document is created based on billing relevance G, posting a credit memo to FI for the returned goods.
